title.narrative: Reduction of TB prevalence by 6 % by 2017 - Bulgaria (01-Oct-2015-30-Sep-2018)

description.narrative: Bulgaria, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Bulgaria (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce the incidence dut to tuberculosis by 40% in 2025 as compared to 2015. To reduce the mortality due to tuberculosis by 40% in 2025 as compared to 2015. The objectives of this program are: To improve TB case detection and treatment success among Roma population. To promote the use of new diagnostic tool, interventions, strategies and enhance operational research and innovation. To reduce the TB transmission among KAP: IDU, TB contact and homeless children, refugees and asylum seekers, diabetics, TB/HIV. To reduce the TB transmission among prisoners. To scale up high quality integrated patient-centered TB care and prevention nationwide and respond to priority challenges to TB control

Treatment success rate - bacteriologically confirmed TB cases

Percentage of HIV-positive patients who were screened for TB in HIV care or treatment settings
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
